datasets.purpose: Acute Food Insecurity Classifications data in different scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) surveys across Mauritania to classify acute food insecurity conditions using standardized classification scales and scenarios. The resulting classifications represent modeled or assessed food security impacts linked to underlying hazards (primarily drought), with projections and reporting dates indicating temporal coverage from 2011.
